## SECTION 1 — Executive Repository Overview

### What LetBuyy Store Actually Is

- LetBuyy is implemented as a pnpm/Turborepo plus Dart/Flutter workspace for a Shopify-class, multi-tenant commerce and site-builder platform.
- The database-owned tenant entity is `sites`; web routes and merchant UI use `store`, `subdomain`, and `store` route terms.
- The repo contains public/consumer web apps, administrative web apps, Cloudflare Hono workers, Supabase SQL migrations, Terraform DNS infrastructure, and Flutter apps/packages.
- The platform includes storefront rendering, merchant admin, identity/onboarding, app marketplace, theme marketplace, internal console/team scaffolds, Flutter builder surfaces, checkout/payment surfaces, analytics surfaces, and generated repository intelligence docs.

### Architecture Style Detected From Code

- Monorepo: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` includes `apps/web/administrative/*`, `apps/web/consumer/*`, `packages/typescript/*`, and `backend/workers/*`.
- Web runtime: Next.js app-router apps using `src/app`, route handlers, middleware files, and per-app Next configs.
- API runtime: Cloudflare Workers using Hono route modules in `backend/workers/api/src/routes` plus a separate `backend/workers/webhooks` worker.
- Data runtime: Supabase Postgres migrations under `backend/supabase/migrations`, Supabase client usage in workers and apps, and RLS policy declarations in SQL.
- Mobile runtime: Flutter/Melos workspace in root `pubspec.yaml`, with apps under `apps/flutter/*` and shared Dart packages under `packages/dart/*`.
- Generated intelligence: root/local `AGENTS.md` files plus topic docs under `docs/` are part of the repo operating model.

## SECTION 3 — Full Monorepo Architecture Analysis

### Workspace Configuration Facts

- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` includes web apps, TypeScript packages, and Cloudflare worker packages.
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` does not include `apps/flutter/*` or `packages/dart/*`; Flutter is owned by root `pubspec.yaml` workspace instead.
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml` does not include alias package directories such as `packages/ui`, `packages/db`, `packages/api`, `packages/shared`, `packages/auth`, `packages/payments`, `packages/config`, or app alias directories under `apps/merchant`, `apps/storefront`, `apps/internal`.
- Root `turbo.json` build/lint/typecheck tasks depend on `^build`, which means lint/typecheck can be blocked by build/package errors before app-level checks run.
- Root `package.json` declares `pnpm@10.6.2`, while npm wrappers cannot find local `turbo` without node_modules. This was proven by `docs/architecture/validation/typecheck.log`.

## SECTION 17 — Workspace Restructuring Plan

### Ideal Monorepo Structure

```text
apps/
  web/
    accounts/              # merchant identity and onboarding UI
    merchant/              # merchant admin/dashboard UI
    storefront/            # tenant storefront renderer and customer account
    landing/               # marketing only
    app-marketplace/       # app marketplace
    theme-marketplace/     # theme marketplace
    console/               # platform super-admin
    team/                  # internal employee portal
  flutter/
    builder/
    console/
    team/
backend/
  workers/
    api/                   # canonical /v1 API gateway
    webhooks/              # provider webhooks only
  supabase/
packages/
  contracts/               # generated TS + Dart API contracts
  ui-web/                  # React UI tokens/components
  ui-flutter/              # Flutter UI token/component parity
  auth/
  payments/
  analytics/
  config/
docs/
  architecture/
```

### Refactor Phases

- Phase 0: freeze new app-local API/auth/payment duplication; fix typecheck/lint blockers; correct Flutter path dependencies.
- Phase 1: centralize API contracts with generated TypeScript and Dart clients from worker Zod/OpenAPI source.
- Phase 2: move business logic out of route handlers into worker services and app server utilities.
- Phase 3: split web UI package into tokens, primitives, commerce components, admin data components, and storefront sections.
- Phase 4: align Flutter models/services to generated contracts and remove Firebase/Firestore-only drift unless intentionally separate.
- Phase 5: migrate alias directories into documentation-only compatibility or remove them after stable canonical paths are adopted.

### Generated Root AGENTS.md Operating Contract Requirements
- Root AGENTS.md must name LetBuyy as a multi-tenant commerce/site-builder platform.
- Root AGENTS.md must preserve `sites` database naming and `store` UI/URL naming.
- Root AGENTS.md must require tenant isolation through `site_id`, `store_id`, `subdomain`, or explicit ownership checks.

- Package-level AGENTS.md files must state manifest name, local dependencies, exported contracts, schema ownership, and regeneration rules.

## SECTION 19 — Future Roadmap

### Immediate Stabilization Roadmap
- Fix `backend/workers/api/src/routes/upload.ts` type error so root typecheck reaches all apps.
- Fix ESLint 9 config circular failure in app-store and theme-marketplace so lint reaches all apps.
- Correct Flutter path dependencies in `apps/flutter/builder/pubspec.yaml` or create compatibility package paths.
- Resolve tenant/RLS/soft-delete gaps in migrations or document global/system tables explicitly.
- Remove hardcoded payment key identifiers and consolidate payment provider config.

### Synchronization Roadmap
- Generate an API contract from worker schemas and produce TypeScript and Dart clients from one source.
- Add contract tests comparing worker response shapes, TypeScript API types, and Dart models.
- Move shared commerce state transitions into services with identical tests for web and Flutter clients.

### Architecture Modernization Roadmap
- Make the Cloudflare worker the canonical API owner for auth-adjacent, payment, order, product, customer, analytics, and tenant mutation flows.
- Keep Next route handlers as BFF/proxy surfaces only where cookies or app-router integration require them.
- Introduce package ownership boundaries for auth, payments, analytics, contracts, config, and UI tokens.

### Design System Roadmap
- Create shared semantic tokens and export them to CSS variables plus Flutter ThemeData.
- Replace app-local duplicate UI primitives with `packages/typescript/ui` and `packages/dart/ui_kit` parity components.
- Add visual regression coverage for storefront/theme/admin high-traffic screens.

### Mobile Parity Roadmap
- Fix Dart package paths, then run `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` cleanly.
- Replace hand-maintained Dart models with generated models where possible.
- Align mobile auth/session flow with the canonical merchant/customer auth boundaries.

### AI Commerce Roadmap
- Put AI features behind tenant-scoped APIs and usage metering.
- Store prompts/results in auditable tenant-owned tables.
- Build merchant-safe product/content generation with moderation, rate limits, and rollback.
